name: pop3-remailer
description: POP3S to Gmail importer powered by Firebase Functions v2

scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace functions && npm run lint --workspace web
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix --workspace functions && npm run lint:fix --workspace web
scripts.format: npm run format --workspace functions && npm run format --workspace web
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check --workspace functions && npm run format:check --workspace web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace functions && npm run typecheck --workspace web
scripts.build: npm run --silent set:auto-version && npm run build --workspace functions && npm run build --workspace web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace functions && npm run test --workspace web -- --watch=false
scripts.coverage: npm run coverage --workspace functions && npm run coverage --workspace web
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test
